text: We couldn’t be happier with Dreamland Ponies! Sarah and her team went above and beyond to make my son’s party a total success, while maintaining the highest degree of covid-19 protocols. When I told the owner that my son loves knights, she worked with me to design an amazing knight pony costume that perfectly complimented the party. My children talk about the ponies every day. If you have only one vendor to pick for your special event, cancel the rest and just hire the ponies—you won’t regret it and your kids will truly be in dreamland! Thank you, Sarah! Highly recommend!

My daughter Absolutely LOVED Her unicorn birthday pony surprise! Sarah was AMAZING! We set everything up to be a surprise for my daughters 5th bday. From the moment I contacted dreamland ponies Sarahs communication through this process was perfect! Strait forward, on time, quick to set up, she even dressed up herself which was totally unexpected! she gave great instructions to keep my daughter safe and having fun and most importantly she made her feel comfortable. Thank you Sarah for making her day a dream come true, she’s still talking about it ????

With this year's restrictions due to Covid-19, I knew my daughter wouldn't be able to have her typically birthday party. She had already suffered so many losses due to the pandemic and I was desperate to find something new, fun and magical to brighten her day. When I found Dreamland Ponies and spoke with Sarah I was so excited. Sarah worked with me to plan the perfect surprise, she even took the time to incorporate her favorite colors, glitter, accessories etc.. making sure my little girl felt like a magical princess for the day. Thanks to Dreamland Ponies and Sarah my little girl had the best day of her life and still asks when we will visit "Tinkerbell" again. If you are in search for a unique special experience for your kids or family I would definitely recommend this company!! We will be back next year and hopefully for a full birthday party with friends if restrictions are lifted. Thanks once again to Sarah and Dreamland Ponies for everything.
My daughter loved the beautiful unicorn at her party. The lady is very friendly and professional. She’s organized, great with communicating and really makes it magical a experience. We recommend!

Dreamland Ponies treated us like family. My daughter turned 3 on Sunday and little ‘Tinkerbell the white Unicorn’ gave rides to Samaras friends, by proper masked/ COVID requirements. Sarah and Maddie came dressed up like whimsical fairy godmothers and it made the party just that much more wonderful. I can’t recommend this creative service enough! Tinkerbell was the sweetest, most patient little pony, and we want to thank all of her hard work, too. We would love to have another party for our 2 month old, Aliyah, when she’s older, and will be looking forward to that day :)

Thank you Dreamland Ponies for making my daughters 3rd birthday party so magical. ????. It will never be forgotten! The unicorn pony was absolutely perfect. You have such an incredible talent and I could not say enough great things about you. I truly appreciated your time and patience with all of the kids. You were so sweet and genuine. It was the best day.
Thank you Dreamland ponies for the most magical party for my magical little girl!
We strive to make each and every High Tea a unique experience with a special surprise! Thank you to Dreamland Ponies for making this one of our favorite surprises yet!

We had a magical experience with dreamland ponies. Not only were the ponies truly spectacular but the owners went above and beyond to make the experience special at our fundraiser on very short notice. Hands down the BEST.

Thank you Dreamland Ponies for blowing the minds of my daughter and her friends at her 6th birthday party. The unicorns were so beautiful and sweet and made the party spectacular and over the top when the 'fairies and pirates' used their 'magic power rings' to make the unicorns appear at the end of their treasure hunt. It was such a magical moment when they opened their eyes and saw all the ponies standing there - brought tears to my eyes. The reveal of the unicorns was more than I had imagined and the looks on their faces was priceless!

Sarah was super fun and wonderful! She brought Prince Charming, a Shetland pony, all kitted out as a glittery unicorn with silver saddle too. All the children absolutely loved taking turns riding. The pony was very well trained and Sarah is great with the kids!!! Best birthday ever! Thank you so much Sarah!!!

We had Dreamland Ponies bring a pony to our unicorn birthday party! WE LOVED IT! Sarah was so kind and easy to work with. She was amazing at maneuvering the horse and very aware of the backgrounds for pictures which I really appreciated. Our girls were in heaven! And she was so sweet with the kiddos and teaching them how to give the pony kisses. We had the horse named Prince Charming and he was the sweetest horse! Balloons popped and he wasn't phased, and he was totally fine with kids running around him and jumping on his back! It was such a wonderful day!! Thanks so much Dreamland Ponies!!!
Thank you Dreamland Ponies for making my little girl's birthday party extra special!
Thank you Sarah Kessler and Dreamland Ponies for all of your creativity and hard work to create a magical pony experience!!
Brooklyn's 4th birthday was epic! Thank you Dreamland Ponies for bringing your amazing my little ponies!!!
